title: Lab - Deploying a chart with Helm
description: Install, customise and inspect a release.
scenario: Install, customise and inspect a release. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Install
tasks.instructions: Install the bitnami apache chart as release amaze-surf.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Customise
tasks.instructions: Install nginx as release happy-browse with replicaCount=2.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Inspect
tasks.instructions: Which chart version did amaze-surf use, and how many revisions does it have?
